notes.verified: Puck envelope/feet are from the V6 CAD; 8.2 mm case/plate profile is annotated in Keebart's lowprofile.webp product image.
notes.measure_before_printing: Keyboard foot size/positions and 16 mm underside-to-keycap height are adjustable assumptions, not published Keebart dimensions. Puck feet are CAD assumptions; measure the fitted rubber feet. No exact Keebart case outline is claimed.
notes.placement: Default: inner straight edge of the right half; keyboard extends toward +X, USB exits toward +Y. Position along that edge using the fit coupon. Do not mirror blindly: the existing puck's USB port is offset.
